Yacon Syrup

About This Entry

Yacon Syrup is a canonical Andean root syrup for low-glycemic sweetening ingredient in global cookery — its sweetness character, texture, and pairing behavior pair with dessert wines, sparkling styles, and spice-friendly reds when used as a primary sweetener.
